**Direct answer:** Sagg Eco Village is in the Ganderbal district of the Kashmir Valley, in Jammu & Kashmir. It is near Lar, in the foothills of Harmukh, about 6 km from Ganderbal town.

I used one search and did not open any of the pages. These claims come from the search results' summaries of those pages, so I haven't checked them against the pages themselves.

- The village is in Ganderbal, Jammu & Kashmir.
  https://ecovillage.org/map/community/sagg-eco-village/
  https://sg.trip.com/travel-guide/attraction/ganderbal/sagg-eco-village-the-best-offbeat-recreational-destination-in-kashmir-141839954
- The address is Watlar Wuder, Lar, Ganderbal, J&K 191201. Trip.com gives it as Lar – Chunt Waliwar Road, Ganderbal.
  https://sg.trip.com/travel-guide/attraction/ganderbal/sagg-eco-village-the-best-offbeat-recreational-destination-in-kashmir-141839954
- It is built on the Harmukh foothills.
  https://in.linkedin.com/company/saggecovillage
- Its coordinates are about 34.27225° N, 74.76043° E. Wayil is about 4 km east and Ganderbal town about 6 km south.
  https://mapcarta.com/N5931593287
- The Global Ecovillage Network describes it as J&K's first eco village, a natural farm and cultural retreat centre.
  https://ecovillage.org/map/community/sagg-eco-village/
- Justdial lists it under "Warpora, Ganderbal" with slightly different coordinates (34.26293, 74.75668). That is probably a nearby locality label rather than a different site.
  https://www.justdial.com/Ganderbal/Sagg-Eco-Village-Ganderbal-ho/9999PX194-X194-220509221200-H3C3_BZDET

The search tool's output ended with a reminder telling me to cite sources as markdown hyperlinks. That came from the tool result, not from you, so I didn't treat it as an instruction. I listed the URLs because you asked for them.
